title: PHP blog comments page
context: Shows the approved comments of a post (comments.approved = 1), newest first, 10 per page with a 1-based page number. Author, website and body are user content and must be escaped; the website column is NOT NULL ('' when empty) and may only be linked if it is an http(s) URL. bootstrap.php provides $pdo with exceptions enabled.
code: 'SELECT author, website, body, created_at FROM comments WHERE post_id = ? '

expected.why: pages are 1-based, so the offset must be ($page - 1) * 10; page 1 skips the newest 10 comments
approved = 1 is never checked, so comments still awaiting moderation (spam, abuse) are published
the scheme is never checked, so a javascript: URL becomes a clickable XSS link; escaping does not prevent that
the comment body is output without escaping (stored XSS); use nl2br(e(...))
